CustomField.description:
Used in Household creation flow for differentiating existing Households
Caution: This field was installed from an Education Trailblazers Association solution. Before editing, ensure changes won't break automation.
CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK("/" + EDUtb_Account__c , EDUtb_Account__r.Name + " (" + EDUtb_Account__r.BillingStreet + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(EDUtb_Account__r.BillingStreet)), ", ", "") + EDUtb_Account__r.BillingCity + IF((NOT(ISBLANK(EDUtb_Account__r.BillingCity)) && NOT(ISBLANK(EDUtb_Account__r.BillingState))), ", ", "") + EDUtb_Account__r.BillingState + ")")
CustomField.label: Account Name & Address
